svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One piece of 5 mm 6082-T6 plate, waterjet or laser cut. Outline:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge (the edge toward the trunk): 175 long at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom, 175 high at the front; 55 high at the back end; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top runs 60 back from the front edge, then slopes down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: load eye 22 at 150 back, 28 up; spare eye 22 at 70

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back, 28 up; lightening hole 36 at 85 back, 90 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain slots: two, 7.5 wide, 25 deep from the top edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 15 and 43 back from the front edge. Cut them

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square and file every edge smooth; no burr may touch chain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock pin hole 8.5 at 29 back, 139 up (drill after the cheeks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: are welded on, through all three plates).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not thicken the plate: a link must span it (5 mm only).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the eye edges to 2 mm radius after the rings go on.
